exercises.why: **снёс** — снести́ (perfective): to carry down; to carry to; to pull down, to demolish; to blow off, to blow away (of the wind). Wiktionary: с- + нести́.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to drift (on); to carry, to waft, to deposit, to wash ashore (e.g. of snow, sand, etc.)
to take away, to take off, to carry (away)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: нанести́ — to drift (on); to carry, to waft, to deposit, to wash ashore (e.g. of snow, sand, etc.); уноси́ть — to take away, to take off, to carry (away); занести́ — to bring, to carry (in); подноси́ть — to bring, to carry (to).

exercises.q: Her kisses take me to heaven.
exercises.why: **уносят** — уноси́ть (imperfective): to take away, to take off, to carry (away); (figuratively) to take (a life), to claim (a life). Wiktionary: у- + носи́ть.
